newsitem.title: USA: Sears to open "home environment" departments.
newsitem.headline: Sears to open "home environment" departments.

text.p: Sears, Roebuck and Co said Wednesday it will open "home environment" departments in 300 stores this year to tap consumer demand for security systems and air and water treatment products.
Sears said it was seeking to cater to growing demand for household comfort products such as humidifiers and PC-based home security systems.

"In addition to consumer trends, our sales figures and research indicate that many families want to take steps to improve the quality of life in their homes," said Bill Collins, vice president of Sears home environment center.

The retailer began testing the "home environment" shops last fall. It said sales of water treatment products have risen by double digits, and air clearner product sales have increased by more than 25 percent.
Sears plans to open more of the departments in other stores next year but did not say how many.
